name: Dr. John Beaulieu
reason: His public home is BioSonics (biosonics.com, read 4 Nov 2026), the tuning-fork company that sells his instruments and books; the site is mainly a shop, and its teaching material is framed largely around health (tinnitus and vagus nerve protocols, 'Working with Cancer and Health Challenges', a naturopathic doctor's clinical framing). That is a brand and health-led work, so it fails the health-claim and brand rules. His Shift course was not checked: theshiftnetwork.com refuses our fetches.
